agents.name: tag-PK128
agents.sequence_source: Body names the tag (F)-EYEKpalmEYE and the bicyclic peptide PK128; the concatenated sequence matches PEPlife2's EYEKEYEACRWPARCVHQDLCG
agents.dose_route_quote: Female Sprague Dawley rats were injected with 0.5 mg kg-1 tag-UK18, 0.5 mg kg-1 tag-PK128, 0.3 mg kg-1 UK18 or 0.25 mg kg-1 tag ... via the tail vein
agents.pk_quote: The tagged bicyclic peptides had elimination half-lives of 2.9+/-0.7 (tag-PK128) and 7.4+/-0.2 h (tag-UK18)

agents.name: tag-UK18
agents.sequence_source: Body names the tag and bicyclic peptide UK18; concatenation matches PEPlife2
agents.dose_route_quote: Female Sprague Dawley rats were injected with 0.5 mg kg-1 tag-UK18, 0.5 mg kg-1 tag-PK128, 0.3 mg kg-1 UK18 or 0.25 mg kg-1 tag ... via the tail vein
agents.pk_quote: The tagged bicyclic peptides had elimination half-lives of 2.9+/-0.7 (tag-PK128) and 7.4+/-0.2 h (tag-UK18)

agents.name: UK18 (non-tagged control)
agents.sequence_source: Body names UK18 as a bicyclic urokinase inhibitor; sequence from PEPlife2, not printed in body
agents.dose_route_quote: Female Sprague Dawley rats were injected with 0.5 mg kg-1 tag-UK18, 0.5 mg kg-1 tag-PK128, 0.3 mg kg-1 UK18 or 0.25 mg kg-1 tag ... via the tail vein

agents.pk_quote: the non-tagged control peptide UK18 had an elimination half-life of 18+/-1 min indicating that the conjugation prolonged the circulation time 25-fold

agents.name: tag alone
agents.sequence_source: Body gives the tag as (F)-EYEKpalmEYE; the bare peptide moiety is EYEKEYE
agents.dose_route_quote: Female Sprague Dawley rats were injected with 0.5 mg kg-1 tag-UK18, 0.5 mg kg-1 tag-PK128, 0.3 mg kg-1 UK18 or 0.25 mg kg-1 tag ... via the tail vein
agents.pk_quote: The tag alone had a longer elimination half-life (12.3+/-0.4 h) than the tagged bicyclic peptides

concentration_time_figure.note: Plasma concentration vs time for tag-PK128, tag-UK18, UK18 and the tag alone; a two-compartment model was fitted.

bioanalytical_method: RP-HPLC (Agilent 1260) with fluorescence detection (ex 445 nm, em 535 nm) on ethanol-precipitated plasma, quantified against standard curves in plasma; two-compartment PK model
bioanalytical_quote: The samples were analysed by RP-HPLC (Agilent 1260 HPLC system) equipped with a fluorescence detector
notes: All seven PEPlife2 values for this PMID were verified against Table 2 and agree exactly: tag-PK128 0.9/2.9, tag-UK18 1.0/7.4, UK18 0.30 (beta only, alpha n.d.), tag 1.5/12.3 h. This is a two-compartment study, so alpha and beta are separate records and must not be pooled - the spread between them within one animal is up to 8-fold. UK18's 0.30 h agrees with the body's independent statement of 18+/-1 min. The rabbit FXIIa-inhibitor arm (5.2+/-0.4 h tagged vs 13+/-2 min untagged) is a different species and is not part of the rat cohort. Note the authors state the tag binds rat albumin five- to sevenfold more weakly than human albumin, so these rat half-lives understate the expected human values.
